metadata.title: Derek Sivers | Substack
metadata.description: Author of Useful Not True, How to Live, Hell Yeah or No, Anything You Want, etc. I’ve been a musician, circus performer, entrepreneur, and speaker. I’m a slow thinker, explorer, xenophile, and love a different point of view. Click to read Derek Sivers on Substack.
